scopes.kenya: Kenya as a whole, not Nairobi

nairobi_gcp.source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics, Gross County Product 2024

meta.caveat: Very little economic data is published for Nairobi alone. Everything marked Kenya is national and is labelled that way on purpose.

sources.what: Nairobi's output and its share of the economy
sources.who: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics, Gross County Product 2024
KNBS census tables via census.ke (Open Institute)

series.label: People in Nairobi
series.source: Kenya census counts, 1969 to 2019 (KNBS and its predecessors)
series.note: Census counts, not estimates. Six points in fifty years, and nothing in between.

series.label: People per square kilometre in Nairobi
series.source: Census counts divided by the county's 705 km²
series.note: Honest division of two sourced numbers, on today's boundary.

series.label: Output per person in Nairobi
series.source: KNBS, Gross County Product 2024, Annexe IV (current prices)
series.note: Gross County Product per person, in shillings of each year. Five years are all KNBS has published on this basis.

Share of all Kenyans living in Nairobi
series.source: Census counts for Nairobi over census counts for Kenya
